objective: test conformal and topological versions of the noncommuting or nonlinear axial-coefficient selector

nodes.branch: four-dimensional conformal covariance forbids the axial operator
nodes.result: sqrt(g) S_mu J5^mu has total Weyl weight zero

nodes.branch: topology quantizes the axial matter coefficient
nodes.result: the density has nonzero local fermion and torsion variations and is not a characteristic class

nodes.blocker: no enlarged algebra representation and invariant action supplies an additional Ward identity beyond conformal covariance

nodes.branch: specific anomaly or topological selection theorem
nodes.blocker: no anomaly polynomial or quantized invariant is shown to contain or constrain the local axial matter coefficient
no complete matter-gravity beta functional, fixed point, critical surface and threshold trajectory is supplied

scope: locally testable conformal-weight and characteristic-class routes for selecting the axial-torsion matter coefficient
decision: The operator is Weyl invariant and locally variable, so generic conformal enlargement and topological quantization do not select its coefficient. Every survivor requires a specific new enlarged action, anomaly theorem or interacting fixed point.
